description: Calculate monthly payments for auto loan and leases in seconds. Adjust price, down payment, trade-in, incentives, taxes, fees, and term to see how each change affects monthly and total cost. Explore advanced breakdowns with charts, payoff timing, and a year-by-year loan amortization view. This app is suitable for all ages.

defaultPrompt: Help me calculate my monthly payment on a new car...
What's my monthly payment if I lease a $50,000 car?
What are my payments if I lease a car worth $25,000?
